blind.B1: Yes. Acute 30-min cycling bout (85% HRmax) in 20 NGT + 28 T2D; leg subcutaneous adipose biopsies PRE (basal), POST (0 min), REC (3 h) (S4.3.1.p1, S2.1.p1). All 143 samples are exercise-time-course samples; PRE is the within-person control. No non-exercise control arm.
blind.B2: Per diagnosis: POST vs PRE and REC vs PRE, NGT (n=20 per time) and T2D (n=28 per time); paper counts NGT POST 712, T2D POST 893, T2D REC 4316 (S2.1.p1); basal T2D vs NGT 589. GEO metadata: PRE 48, POST 47, REC 48; NGT 60, T2D 83 samples.
blind.B3: Yes: three biopsies per participant. Key: characteristics_ch1.2.participant id (= pid; = title prefix), 48 keys, links 143/143, no duplicates in a level.

summary: 该案例设计正确：按诊断分层、以 PRE 为对照、对 POST 和 REC 分别比较，并用参与者固定效应处理每人三次活检。矩阵为 CPM，走 limma(log2CPM+1) 路线，偏离论文 voom/duplicateCorrelation 的情况已如实记录。阈值转录正确；DEG 数量比论文多 1.35–2 倍已在 HANDBACK 中说明，无阻塞或主要问题。
